name: Hardware panel screenshots

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - ui-preview
    paths:
      - 'src/plugin/**'
      - 'src/core/**'
      - 'src/tools/ui_snapshot.cpp'
      - 'tests/*.h'
      - 'scripts/run-ui-smoke-linux.sh'
      - 'CMakeLists.txt'
      - '.github/workflows/screenshots.yml'

permissions:

run: cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
      - name: Build screenshot renderer and core tests
        run: cmake --build build --target CS80Snapshots cs80_tests --parallel 2
      - name: Verify core
        run: ./build/cs80_tests
      - name: Capture actual editor at every supported size and page
        id: capture_panel
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/ui
          status=0
          JUCE_FONT_PATH=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu bash scripts/run-ui-smoke-linux.sh ./build/CS80Snapshots_artefacts/Release/CS80Snapshots --out artifacts/ui --self-test > artifacts/run.log 2>&1 || status=$?
          cat artifacts/run.log
          cp artifacts/run.log artifacts/ui/run.log
          if (( status != 0 )); then
              # Run logs are not always downloadable; surface the evidence as an annotation too.
              msg=$(tail -n 40 artifacts/run.log | sed 's/%/%25/g' | awk '{printf "%s%%0A", $0}')
              echo "::error title=UI smoke exit ${status}::${msg}"
              exit "$status"
          fi
          printf '{"commit":"%s","run":"%s","renderer":"JUCE software, actual plugin editor"}\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" > artifacts/ui/provenance.json
          sha256sum artifacts/ui/*.png > artifacts/ui/SHA256SUMS
      - name: Publish screenshot evidence
        if: always() && (steps.capture_panel.outcome == 'success' || steps.capture_panel.outcome == 'failure')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
